errors.text_span: with tick labels at intervals of 128

errors.text_span: with the red line consistently having the highest ratio
errors.evidence: The red line does not consistently have the highest ratio; at the x-axis value of 512, it is tied with the orange line at a ratio of approximately 0.42.

errors.text_span: and the green line the lowest
